target.title: Add configurable Talk idle timeout
target.body:
## Summary
- add an opt-in `talk.idleTimeoutS` config field and expose it through the Talk config gateway/protocol contract
- wire macOS Talk Mode to auto-disable after idle listening time and return to Voice Wake waiting
- document the new field and cover config/protocol/Swift parsing behavior with tests

Fixes #46844.

## Problem context
Voice Wake can enable Talk Mode, but current macOS Talk only treats `silenceTimeoutMs` as the short intra-turn pause before finalizing a non-empty transcript. When Talk is listening with an empty transcript between turns, `checkSilence()` returns and Talk stays active indefinitely. After assistant replies or `chat.send` failures, the runtime also resumes listening instead of handing control back to Voice Wake. That leaves Voice Wake-triggered Talk sessions alive until the user stops them manually.

The public Talk config and gateway protocol also have no idle-timeout field today, and the strict config/protocol schemas would reject one. This PR keeps the contract additive and opt-in: leaving `talk.idleTimeoutS` unset preserves the existing manual-stop behavior, while setting a positive integer arms idle auto-deactivation.

## Behavior
- `talk.idleTimeoutS` accepts positive integer seconds in config and protocol payloads
- unset, zero, non-integer, and string values stay rejected or normalized away according to the existing config path
- macOS Talk resets idle activity on user speech/transcript updates and when a turn finishes/resumes listening
- the idle timer only fires while Talk is in `listening` with no pending transcript, so it does not replace `silenceTimeoutMs` or cut off thinking/speaking phases
- when the timer expires, Talk disables through `AppStateStore.shared.setTalkEnabled(false)`, which lets the existing controller teardown resume Voice Wake waiting

## Validation

- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 apps/macos/Sources/OpenClaw/TalkModeRuntime.swift apps/macos/Sources/OpenClaw/TalkModeGatewayConfig.swift apps/macos/Tests/OpenClawIPCTests/TalkModeConfigParsingTests.swift apps/macos/Tests/OpenClawIPCTests/TalkModeGatewayConfigTests.swift apps/shared/OpenClawKit/Sources/OpenClawKit/TalkConfigParsing.swift apps/shared/OpenClawKit/Tests/OpenClawKitTests/TalkConfigContractTests.swift apps/shared/OpenClawKit/Tests/OpenClawKitTests/TalkConfigParsingTests.swift src/config/types.gateway.ts src/config/zod-schema.ts src/config/talk.ts packages/gateway-protocol/src/schema/channels.ts packages/gateway-protocol/src/talk-config.contract.test.ts src/config/zod-schema.talk.test.ts src/config/config.talk-validation.test.ts src/config/talk.normalize.test.ts src/config/schema.help.ts src/config/schema.labels.ts src/config/schema.help.quality.test.ts src/gateway/server.talk-config.test.ts docs/nodes/talk.md docs/gateway/config-agents.md docs/gateway/configuration-reference.md test/fixtures/talk-config-contract.json`

## Notes
- `swift test --package-path apps/shared/OpenClawKit --filter TalkConfig` was attempted locally but the package build stopped before the targeted tests because the CLI Swift environment could not load existing SwiftUI macro plugins (`SwiftUIMacros.EntryMacro` / `PreviewsMacros`).
- This is intentionally draft while maintainers decide whether the public lifecycle contract should remain a general opt-in Talk setting or be narrowed to Voice Wake-started Talk sessions only.
